name: Kanbe Keisuke
source:
A cool gentleman, but still a loving father to Kotori. Even now, he still falls head over heels for his wife. He's a member of the hunting club and now helps to exterminate animal pests.

[spoiler]When Kotori was young, he died in the car accident and turned into a familiar.[/spoiler]

Edited from the Memories.
